visualCharacteristics.purpose: Searchable, filterable, sortable and paginated grid of employee stories
visualCharacteristics.layout: Filter bar on a tinted panel (Search Blogs input with search button; Filter Posts with Roles and Topics dropdowns and a Clear Filters link; Sort By dropdown), results count, 3-up grid of story tiles (2 from 600px, 1 on mobile), numbered pagination with prev/next arrows and ellipsis (1 2 3 … 13)
visualCharacteristics.cards: Same tile treatment as cards.story-grid: 16:9 image, H3 title linked to the story (whole tile clickable), publish date, short description

contentPattern.structure: Configuration only: two-cell key | value rows (read with readBlockConfig). Cards, filters and pagination are built at runtime from the site query index merged with the external-stories sheet.

rows.Filters: Comma-separated facets to show (default: Roles, Topics)
rows.Sort: Default sort: Newest, Oldest, Title A-Z or Title Z-A (default: Newest)
rows.Roles: Comma-separated Roles dropdown options; if omitted, derived from the stories
rows.Topics: Comma-separated Topics dropdown options; if omitted, derived from the stories
rows.Path: Optional path prefix for index entries (default: /blog/)
rows.Exclude: Optional comma-separated listing paths to drop (default: /blog, /blog/authors, /blog/search)

dataSources.queryIndex: EDS sheet JSON with columns path, title, description, image, date (falls back to lastModified), roles, topics, author; roles/topics comma-separated
dataSources.externalStories: EDS sheet JSON with columns title, url, image, description, date, roles, topics; links open off-site in the same tab with rel=noopener

contentPattern.example: Filters | Roles, Topics; Page Size | 9; Sort | Newest; Roles | Commercial Markets, Consumer Markets, ...; Topics | Awards and Recognition, Blue Shield Foundation, ...

notes: Our People (/blog) story listing: authored as 'Story Listing' with Filters, Page Size, Sort, Roles and Topics rows

reuseGuidance: Use 'Story Listing' wherever a filterable index of blog stories is needed (for example /blog/search). Author only configuration rows; stories come from the query index (pages under the Path prefix) and the external-stories sheet. For a short related-stories strip on articles, reuse /scripts/story-index.js (loadStories, filterStories, sortStories) rather than this block.
